definitions.gloss: expressive ability; power of expression; expressiveness
definitions.explanation: The ability to convey thoughts, feelings, or ideas effectively through language, art, music, dance, or other creative means.

examples.japanese: {表現力|ひょうげんりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{表現力|ひょうげんりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れている→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧。
examples.english: This painter excels in expressive ability.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表現力|ひょうげんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}かせている→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I have the children draw pictures to develop their expressive ability.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧ (expression) + {力|りょく} (power, ability). Refers to the capacity to express oneself effectively, whether through words, art, music, acting, or other media. Highly valued in Japanese education and artistic contexts.

- {表現力|ひょうげんりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧: rich in expressiveness
- {表現力|ひょうげんりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れる→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧: to excel in expression
- {表現力|ひょうげんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧: to polish one's expressive skills
